name: Say You Love Me
source:
A young man meets a strange teenage girl standing in the road. By the time the encounter is over, he may wish he'd have stayed in bed that morning.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=11336]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
